query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded_valid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as geocoded_failed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NULL AND zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_geocode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NULL OR zip = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_address
FROM pco_people 
WHERE status = 'active';
